raw.details:
THE OUTPOST

6-Hour Frontend Hackathon

One Problem. One Builder. Six Hours.

REGISTER NOW

Registration Form: click here fill

Registration Fee: ₹30 per participant

Important Registration Instructions:

  • Filling out the official registration form is mandatory to be eligible for participation.

  • Participants must complete the ₹30 registration fee payment and submit valid payment details for verification.

  • Only participants whose payments have been successfully verified will be added to the official WhatsApp group.

  • All important announcements, the problem statement, event instructions, deadlines, and submission details will be shared through the official WhatsApp group.

  • Submitting the form alone does not confirm your registration. Confirmation is subject to payment verification.

About THE OUTPOST

Welcome to THE OUTPOST, a fast-paced individual frontend hackathon where creativity meets engineering.

You will receive one problem statement and six hours to transform your ideas into a polished, functional, and responsive digital experience. Showcase your frontend development skills, experiment with modern technologies, and build something remarkable under pressure.

Hackathon Details

  • Format: Individual Participation

  • Duration: 6 Hours

  • Mode: Online

  • Domain: Frontend Development

  • Problem Statements: One

  • Backend Development: Not Allowed

  • Technology: Modern Frontend Stack Required

Technology Requirements

Participants must use a modern frontend technology stack such as React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, or other modern frontend frameworks and libraries.

Backend development is not permitted. Your project should demonstrate your own creativity, UI/UX decisions, technical skills, responsiveness, and problem-solving ability.

Dynamic Prize Pool

The prize pool will increase as registrations grow.

  • Before 100 registrations: ₹500 prize pool

  • At 100 registrations: ₹1,500 prize pool

Further prize pool increases may be announced as additional registration milestones are reached.

Your Mission

One problem statement. Six hours. One builder.

Think strategically, design thoughtfully, build independently, and deliver your best frontend experience before time runs out.

Welcome to THE OUTPOST. Your mission starts with registration.
